evidence: Three top-level packages (http_prompt, tests, docs) with clear separation of concerns
Core functionality organized into cohesive modules (cli, execution, context, completer, lexer, etc.) with well-defined responsibilities
No external service boundaries or network communication patterns; all components run in a single process
Context and execution logic tightly integrated within the main package, with clear internal dependencies
Test suite mirrors the source structure, indicating a single deployable unit
Use of internal relative imports (e.g., from .context import Context) confirms monolithic deployment
Repository depth of 3 levels suggests reasonable modularity without excessive nesting
risks: Potential for tight coupling between modules as project scales
Limited scalability for distributed deployments without refactoring
Testing may become slower as monolith grows due to shared state in context
